    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    # Separator lines are full rows/columns of a color distinct from background.
    rows=[r for r in range(h) if len(set(grid[r]))==1 and grid[r][0] not in (0,)]
    # test input separator is row of 8; panels above and below, source is lower panel.
    if rows:
        sepcolor=grid[rows[0]][0]
        rowcuts=[r for r in rows if all(v==sepcolor for v in grid[r])]
        panels=[]; a=0
        for r in rowcuts+[h]:
            if r>a: panels.append((a,r))
            a=r+1
        if len(panels)>1:
            sa,sb=panels[-1]; src=[row[:] for row in grid[sa:sb]]
            bh=len(src)
            # infer separators in columns by full-height uniform color
            cols=[c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c]==sepcolor for r in range(h))]
            colpanels=[]; a=0
            for c in cols+[w]:
                if c>a: colpanels.append((a,c))
                a=c+1
            sw=len(src[0])
            for pa,pb in panels:
                for r in range(pa,pb):
                    for ca,cb in colpanels:
                        for c in range(ca,cb): grid[r][c]=src[(r-pa)%bh][(c-ca)%sw]
            return grid
    # No complete horizontal separator: use first complete vertical separator.
    cols=[c for c in range(w) if len({grid[r][c] for r in range(h)})==1]
    if cols:
        color=grid[0][cols[0]]
        bands=[]; a=0
        for c in cols+[w]:
            if c>a: bands.append((a,c))
            a=c+1
        sa,sb=bands[0]; src=[row[sa:sb] for row in grid]; sw=sb-sa
        for a,b in bands:
            for r in range(h):
                for c in range(a,b): grid[r][c]=src[r][(c-a)%sw]
        return grid
    return grid
''')
